name: mod-images
description: Thumbnails of the images pasted into the prompt, in a strip just above it before you send: real pixels in kitty and Ghostty, coloured half-block cells in other terminals, and /mod-images to see what it sees.

height.title: Thumbnail height (rows)
height.description: The tallest the thumbnails get, from 3 to 20 rows. The strip always shrinks to fit the room above the prompt: about 6 rows in an 80x24 terminal, 8 in 120x30.

pictures.title: Pictures
pictures.description: auto (default): real pixels where the terminal draws them (kitty 0.28 or newer, Ghostty, outside tmux and screen), coloured half-block cells elsewhere, and one line of text when NO_COLOR or CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER is set. blocks: always half-block cells. text: one line naming the images; choose it for screen-reader mode turned on in settings or with --ax-screen-reader.
